lines.japanese: 生きとし生けるものすべてが、その生命を次の世代へ受けわたすべくして産まれてきたとするならば、雌雄の出会いとはその大任を果たす上での第一歩だ。
lines.english: If every living thing is born to pass its life on to the next generation, then the meeting of male and female is the first step toward fulfilling that great duty.

lines.japanese: だからヒトは、恋に落ちる。
lines.english: That is why people fall in love.

lines.japanese: だから僕らは、恋をすると無上の歓びを得る。
lines.english: That is why love brings us unsurpassed joy.

lines.japanese: だから僕は、恋しいひとのことを想うだけで温かな気持ちに浸ってしまう。
lines.english: That is why merely thinking of the woman I loved could immerse me in warmth.

lines.japanese: だから僕は、恋人の写真を眺めているだけでこうも胸を弾ませてしまうのだ。
lines.english: That is why simply gazing at my girlfriend's photograph could set my heart dancing.

lines.japanese: 近ごろ僕は幸せだった。
lines.english: I had been happy lately.

lines.japanese: カレンダーは１２月の半ば。
lines.english: The calendar had reached the middle of December.

lines.japanese: 卒業を控えて諸々の悩みや不安もあったけれど、それはそれとして、初めて訪れた人生の春を大事に大事に。
lines.english: With graduation approaching, I had my share of worries and uncertainty. But those were a separate matter. I meant to cherish this first springtime of my life with all my heart.

lines.japanese: たとえば放課後の教室でひとり、小さな画面に収まった彼女の姿を眺めていたり、とか。
lines.english: For example, I might sit alone in the classroom after school, gazing at her image contained within a tiny screen.

lines.japanese: 「羽田」
lines.english: “Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 戸口から出てゆく同級生たちとすれ違いながら、針生さんが教室へ入ってきた。
lines.english: Passing our classmates on their way out through the doorway, Kuroudo entered the classroom.

lines.japanese: 「ン？　なに、おまえまだ帰んねえの」
lines.english: “Hm? What, you still not going home?”

lines.japanese: 席を立とうとしない僕に、彼は眉をひそめた。
lines.english: He frowned when I made no move to stand.

lines.japanese: 僕は携帯電話を畳みながら答える。
lines.english: I folded my phone shut as I answered.

lines.japanese: 「はい、渡来さんを待ってるんです。ちょっと後輩にＣＤを借りてくるって言うんで」
lines.english: “No. I'm waiting for Watarai. She went to borrow a CD from one of the younger students.”

lines.japanese: 「ふうン……」
lines.english: “Hmmm...”

lines.japanese: 針生さんは流し目を送るみたいに渡来さんの席を見た。無人の机に彼女の通学鞄がぶら下がっていた。
lines.english: Kuroudo cast a sidelong glance at Watarai's seat. Her schoolbag hung from the empty desk.

lines.japanese: 「おまえら最近よく一緒にいるなァ」
lines.english: “You two have been together a lot lately.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　ええ、まあ……その……つ、つき、付きあって、ますから……」
lines.english: “What? Um, yes... Well... W-we are... going out now...”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんと正式に交際をすることになって数日。口にするのは座りが悪いというか、実感がないというか、つまり照れる。
lines.english: It had been several days since Watarai and I officially began dating. Saying it aloud still felt strange, or unreal—or, in other words, embarrassing.

lines.japanese: 「あァ、まだドーパミンほとばしる時期だから仕方ねえンだろうけど──」
lines.english: “Well, you're still in the stage where the dopamine's spraying everywhere, so I guess it can't be helped—”

lines.japanese: いかにも恋愛経験が豊富そうな針生さんは、肩を揺らして笑った。
lines.english: Kuroudo, who certainly looked like a man with abundant romantic experience, chuckled with a shake of his shoulders.

lines.japanese: 「──初っ端から飛ばしまくると飽きンのも早いよ。長くもたせたいンだったら、自制してペース配分考えたレンアイしなよチェリーボーイ」
lines.english: “—but if you go full throttle right out of the gate, you'll get bored that much faster. If you want it to last, show some restraint and pace yourselves, lover boy.”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、長くっていうか、ずっと続ける予定ですけど」
lines.english: “I don't just want it to last. I intend for it to last forever.”

lines.japanese: 「ずっとって何。この先結婚して、ガキは何人でとか考えてるわけ」
lines.english: “Forever? What, you're already thinking about getting married and how many kids you'll have?”

lines.japanese: 「はい。渡来さんは男の子が欲しいって言ってました」
lines.english: “Yes. Watarai said she wants a boy.”

lines.japanese: 「ハア？　おまえら面白ぇなあ」
lines.english: “What the hell? You two are hilarious.”

lines.japanese: とくに面白いことを言ったつもりはないのだけど、針生さんは口の端で笑った。
lines.english: I hadn't meant to say anything funny, but the corner of Kuroudo's mouth curled into a grin.

lines.japanese: 「ふッ。今度そんな漫才するときは、ぜひ俺も呼んでほしいね」
lines.english: “Heh. Next time you put on a comedy act like that, be sure to invite me.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、それじゃあ針生さんも一緒に帰ります？　いまからブルボンヌ冴子っていう評判のいい占い師さんに、恋愛運を見てもらいに行くところなんですよ」
lines.english: “Oh, then do you want to walk with us? We’re about to visit a popular fortune-teller named Saeko Bourbonne and have her tell our fortunes in love.”

lines.japanese: 「結構だよ。のぼせあがった若者たちの時間に、年寄りがお邪魔しちゃ悪いでしょう」
lines.english: “No, thank you. An old man shouldn't intrude on two infatuated youngsters.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな。針生さんは、おれと渡来さん共通の親友じゃないですか、ぜんぜん邪魔じゃないですよ」
lines.english: “Don't say that. You're a close friend to both me and Watarai. You wouldn't be intruding at all.”

lines.japanese: 「げらげらげら！　いよいよ腹いてえや。じゃあな、いい家庭築けよマイフレンド」
lines.english: “Geh-ha-ha-ha! Now my stomach really hurts. See you around, my friend. Build yourself a nice family.”

lines.japanese: ぱん、と音高く僕の肩を叩いて針生さんは去っていった。僕は会釈してその背中を見送った。
lines.english: Kuroudo gave my shoulder a loud slap and walked away. I bowed slightly as I watched him go.

lines.japanese: わずかな生徒しか残っていない教室は静かだった。
lines.english: Only a handful of students remained, and the classroom was quiet.

lines.japanese: ペース配分を考えた恋愛ってどういうことだろう。僕は机に頬杖をついて、ふたたび携帯電話を開いた。
lines.english: What did it mean to pace yourself in love? I rested my cheek in one hand and opened my phone again.

lines.japanese: 小さな画面に、体操着姿の渡来さんが映っている。
lines.english: The small screen showed Watarai in her gym uniform.

lines.japanese: 去年──まだ彼女とろくに挨拶も交わせなかったころ──の体育祭の日、美術部作の装飾アーチを撮るふりしてこっそり収めたスナップショット。
lines.english: It was a snapshot from last year's sports festival, when I could barely even exchange greetings with her. I had taken it secretly while pretending to photograph the decorative arch made by the art club.

lines.japanese: あれから一年、僕は何度この画像を呼びだしたことだろう。どことも知れぬ方へ向けられた彼女の表情が──
lines.english: Over the year since, how many times had I called up this image? Her expression, turned toward some place I did not know—

lines.japanese: 「なに見てんの？」
lines.english: “What are you looking at?”

lines.japanese: 「うわああああ！」
lines.english: “Waaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 突如うしろから声をかけられて僕は飛びあがった。振りかえれば、音楽ＣＤを手にした渡来さんが立っている。
lines.english: The sudden voice from behind made me jump. I turned to find Watarai standing there with a music CD in her hand.

lines.japanese: 「な、なに大きな声出して……びっくりした……」
lines.english: “Wh-why'd you yell like that...? You scared me...”

lines.japanese: 驚いたのは僕も同じだ。慌ててケータイをポケットへ押しこみながら取りつくろう。
lines.english: I was every bit as startled. I hurriedly shoved my phone into my pocket and tried to play it off.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの、もう用事は済んだの？　そ、それじゃ帰ろうか」
lines.english: “U-um, are you finished already? Th-then should we go?”

lines.japanese: 「うん、お待たせ。ところで今なんか隠した？」
lines.english: “Yeah. Sorry to keep you. By the way, did you just hide something?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、べつに。なんでもないよ」
lines.english: “No, nothing. It was nothing.”
“Hmmm...?”

lines.japanese: 彼女は体を傾けて、僕の手が潜りこんだ先を訝しげに覗きこんでくる。
lines.english: She leaned in and peered suspiciously toward the pocket where my hand had disappeared.

lines.japanese: 「なんでもないってば。ああ、そうだ、そんなことより──」
lines.english: “I said it was nothing. Oh, right. More importantly—”

lines.japanese: とりあえず話題を変えてしまおう。
lines.english: For now, I would change the subject.

lines.japanese: 「──いま針生さんが出ていったんだけど、すれ違った？」
lines.english: “—Kuroudo just left. Did you pass him?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、うん。なんか無言でニタニタ笑われたから余裕でスルーしたけど、なんなの？」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah. He smirked at me without saying anything, so I ignored the hell out of him. What was that about?”

lines.japanese: 「一緒に帰ろうって誘ったんだけど、断られちゃったんだ。邪魔しちゃ悪いって言うんだよ、全然そんなことないのにね」
lines.english: “I asked him to walk with us, but he turned me down. He said he didn’t want to intrude, even though he wouldn’t be intruding at all.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、邪魔でしょ」
lines.english: “No, he'd definitely be intruding.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あはは……渡来さん、相変わらず針生さんには厳しいね」
lines.english: “Ah-ha-ha... You're as hard on Kuroudo as ever.”

lines.japanese: 「逆。向こうがド厳しいから、こっちも相応の態度で臨んでるだけ」
lines.english: “Other way around. He’s vicious with me, so I’m just giving as good as I get.”

lines.japanese: 涼しい顔でしれっと言いきった。
lines.english: She said it without a trace of concern.

lines.japanese: 「だから針生先輩がいると私、乙女から遠ざかっちゃうんだよね」
lines.english: “That's why having Kuroudo around drags me farther and farther from maidenhood.”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん」
lines.english: “Huh.”

lines.japanese: 「ふーんじゃなくて。そこはフォローしようよ彼氏」
lines.english: “Don't just say ‘huh.’ You're my boyfriend. Stick up for me.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そうか。ええと……」
lines.english: “Oh, right. Um...”

lines.japanese: 「大丈夫だよ、渡来さんはもともと乙女じゃないよ」
lines.english: “Don't worry, Watarai. You were never a maiden to begin with.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだと。それフォローか？」
lines.english: “What the hell? Was that supposed to help?”

lines.japanese: 「ごめん、じゃあ……」
lines.english: “Sorry. Then...”

lines.japanese: 「どんなときだって渡来さんは乙女だよ」
lines.english: “You'll always be a maiden, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「なんか適当ー」
lines.english: “That sounds so half-assed.”

lines.japanese: 「僕にとって渡来さんはいつでも乙女だよ」
lines.english: “You'll always be a maiden to me, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「んー、もうひとつ」
lines.english: “Hmm. One more try.”

lines.japanese: 「僕は乙女じゃない渡来さんも好きだよ」
lines.english: “I love you even when you aren't a maiden.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、それかな」
lines.english: “Yeah. That's the one.”

lines.japanese: 自称乙女はあっさり頷くと、自分の席へスクールバッグを取りに行った。
lines.english: The self-proclaimed maiden nodded readily, then went to retrieve her schoolbag from her desk.

lines.japanese: 「てかさー」
lines.english: “Seriously, though...”

lines.japanese: 後輩に借りてきたアルバムをしまいながら、背を向けたまま続ける。
lines.english: She continued with her back to me as she put away the album she had borrowed from the younger student.

lines.japanese: 「なんでうちの彼氏は、放課後デートに第三者を誘うかなあ」
lines.english: “Why does my boyfriend invite a third wheel on our after-school date?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　だって、おととい森里君のお見舞いに行ったときは、渡来さんだって山科さんを誘って──」
lines.english: “What? When we went to visit Morisato while he was sick the day before yesterday, you invited Yamashina too—”

lines.japanese: 「独り言です。話しかけないでください」
lines.english: “I am talking to myself. Please do not address me.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そう……分かった」
lines.english: “O-okay... Understood.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ……お見舞いと相性占いじゃぜんぜん違うってのに」
lines.english: “Sigh... Visiting a sick friend is completely different from having our compatibility read.”

lines.japanese: ずいぶん滑舌のいい独り言だなあ。
lines.english: That was some remarkably clear enunciation for talking to herself.

lines.japanese: 「あの子ホントに彼氏の自覚あるのか？」
lines.english: “Does that boy have any idea he's somebody's boyfriend?”

lines.japanese: ずいぶん攻撃的な独り言だなあ。
lines.english: That was some pretty aggressive muttering.

lines.japanese: 「考えてほしいよね。針生先輩なんていたら、手つないだりとか出来ないじゃん」
lines.english: “I wish he'd think. If Kuroudo was there, we couldn't do things like hold hands.”
“Hold—”

lines.japanese: しかも乙女な独り言だ。ちょっと嬉しいけど、ちょっと恥ずかしい。
lines.english: And remarkably maidenly, too. I was a little pleased, but a little embarrassed.

lines.japanese: 「渡来さんって、往来でそういうの嫌いなひとだと思ってた……」
lines.english: “I thought you disliked things like that in public, Watarai...”

lines.japanese: 「に、苦手だけど、一応そういう願望はあるのっ」
lines.english: “I-I'm not comfortable with it, but that doesn't mean I don't want to try!”

lines.japanese: 今度は僕の独り言に彼女が口を挟んできた。帰り仕度を済ませてずんずん歩みよってくる。
lines.english: This time she interrupted my talking to myself. Finished preparing to leave, she marched straight toward me.

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ。じゃあ今度、並んで歩いてるときにでもさりげなく手を握ってみるよ」
lines.english: “I see. Then next time we're walking side by side, I'll casually take your hand.”

lines.japanese: 言葉を詰まらせてしまった。頬がほんのり朱に染まっている。
lines.english: She found herself at a loss for words. A faint blush colored her cheeks.

lines.japanese: 「は、羽田君、そういう少女漫画みたいなことよく真顔で言えるね……」
lines.english: “H-Haneda, how can you say something straight out of a girls' manga with such a serious face...?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。彼氏だから」
lines.english: “Because I'm your boyfriend.”

lines.japanese: 今度は横を向いてしまった。ちらりと覗いた耳が赤い。
lines.english: This time she turned away. The ear I glimpsed was red.

lines.japanese: 「やっぱり先輩いなくてよかった。こんなバカップルみたいなノロケシーン、とてもじゃないけど見せらんない……」
lines.english: “I'm really glad Kuroudo isn't here. I'd die if he saw this stupid lovey-dovey flirting...”

lines.japanese: あ、あれ、なんか怒ってる？　いま馬鹿って言われた？
lines.english: W-wait, was she angry? Had she just called me stupid?

lines.japanese: 「あのう、えーと……」
lines.english: “Um, so...”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君」
lines.english: “Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 僕の言葉を遮って、渡来さんは手のひらを突きだしてきた。
lines.english: Watarai cut me off and held out her palm.

lines.japanese: 「ケータイ貸して」
lines.english: “Give me your phone.”

lines.japanese: 「へ？　な、なに……」
lines.english: “Huh? Wh-why...?”

lines.japanese: 「いいから貸して」
lines.english: “Just give it to me.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、それは、ちょっと……」
lines.english: “No, I can't exactly...”

lines.japanese: 「なんで。彼女に知られちゃ困る女の番号でも入ってんの」
lines.english: “Why not? Got some girl's number in there that your girlfriend can't see?”

lines.japanese: 「まさか！」
lines.english: “Of course not!”

lines.japanese: とんでもない濡れ衣だ。
lines.english: What an outrageous false accusation.

lines.japanese: 仕方ない、僕はポケットから携帯電話を抜きだすと、一瞬の早業でそこに写っていた画像を閉じた。
lines.english: I had no choice. I pulled the phone from my pocket and, with one lightning-fast motion, closed the image on its screen.

lines.japanese: 「ハイどもー」
lines.english: “Thanks.”

lines.japanese: 差しだすより先に横取りされたけど、大丈夫、いまディスプレイはただの待ち受け画面だ。
lines.english: She snatched it before I could hold it out, but everything was fine. The display showed nothing but the home screen now.

lines.japanese: 彼女はぽちぽちと幾つかの操作をしたあと、片手でそれを頭上に掲げた。
lines.english: After pressing a few buttons, she raised it high above her head in one hand.

lines.japanese: 「はい、モッツァレラ」
lines.english: “Say mozzarella.”

lines.japanese: ぴろーん。
lines.english: Chime.

lines.japanese: にっこり笑顔とカメラ機能のシャッター音。
lines.english: A bright smile and the click of the phone’s camera.

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Here.”

lines.japanese: そして冷たい声と併せて、僕の手にケータイが戻ってきた。
lines.english: Along with that cold word, the phone returned to my hand.
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「あげる」
lines.english: “You can have it.”
“What? What?”

lines.japanese: 思わず手のひら上の笑顔と、その反対側に立つ拗ねた表情とを交互に見比べてしまった。
lines.english: Without thinking, I looked back and forth between the smile in my palm and the sulking face standing across from it.

lines.japanese: 「その代わり、さっきの隙だらけの顔は恥ずかしいから消しといて」
lines.english: “In exchange, delete that embarrassing picture where my guard was completely down.”

lines.japanese: ばれていた。
lines.english: She had seen it.

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや、あの、あれはね……」
lines.english: “Um, no, that was...”

lines.japanese: 「いい」
lines.english: “It's fine.”

lines.japanese: 釈明しようとしたら止められた。
lines.english: She stopped me before I could explain.

lines.japanese: 「気持ちは分かるから。私も同じだし」
lines.english: “I understand how you feel. I'm the same way.”

lines.japanese: 「同じ？」
lines.english: “The same?”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは不機嫌そうに唇を突きだしたまま頷くと、鞄から自分の携帯電話を取りだした。
lines.english: Still pouting in apparent displeasure, Watarai nodded and took her own phone from her bag.
“Here.”

lines.japanese: ぱかっと開けて、ずいっと突きだす。どこかで見覚えのある間抜けな顔が小さく写っていた。
lines.english: She snapped it open and thrust it at me. A familiar-looking idiot's face appeared in miniature.

lines.japanese: 「あ……あれ？　これって、一年のときの僕……？」
lines.english: “W-wait. Is that me in our first year...?”

lines.japanese: 「三年間、暇さえあれば見てた」
lines.english: “I looked at it whenever I got the chance for three years.”

lines.japanese: そっぽ向いたままむっつりと呟く。僕の彼女は、照れると怒ったみたいになるんだ。
lines.english: She muttered sullenly without turning back. My girlfriend looked angry whenever she was embarrassed.

lines.japanese: 「えっ、ちょっ……やだよそんな口半開きの顔！　消してよ！」
lines.english: “W-wait! No, my mouth's hanging open! Delete that!”

lines.japanese: 「やだ。今の彼氏も好きだけど、昔の羽田君も好きだから」
lines.english: “No. I love my current boyfriend, but I love the old Haneda too.”

lines.japanese: 「なにそれ！　いいよ、じゃあこっちだって昔の渡来さん消さないから」
lines.english: “What does that mean?! Fine, then I'm not deleting the old Watarai either.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょちょちょ、それは困る。それは乙女の肖像権侵害」
lines.english: “W-w-wait, that's not fair! That's a violation of a maiden's portrait rights!”

lines.japanese: 僕らは放課後の教室で、互いの携帯電話を奪いあうように戦った。
lines.english: There in the classroom after school, we fought to steal each other's phones.

lines.japanese: 「げらげらげら。おまえら、ほんっと面白ぇなあ」
lines.english: “Geh-ha-ha-ha! You two really are hilarious.”

lines.japanese: 果たして針生さんがいつからそこに立っていたのか。
lines.english: How long had Kuroudo been standing there?

lines.japanese: 考えると羞恥心で燃えつきそうになる。
lines.english: The thought alone threatened to burn me to ash with shame.
